run_microbenchmark_latency: run the microbenchmark latency profiler to generate latency trace files and analysis reports
run_microbenchmark_perf: run the microbenchmark perf collector to generate flamegraph SVGs for a given benchmark
run_microbenchmark_summary: run the microbenchmark summary collector to output JSON benchmark results with or without counters
collect_latency_fn: call collect_latency to build and profile a benchmark, generating latency trace files and analysis
fnize_fn: call fnize to sanitize a string by replacing angle brackets commas slashes and spaces with underscores
